Downloads a ledger, runs firedancer backtest and solcap diff, and checks ledger checksum.

# Purpose
This Bash script prepares a Solana ledger test data set, runs a Firedancer backtest against it, and then compares the generated `fd.solcap` output with the reference `solana.solcap` file. It first loads shared test helpers from `contrib/test/ledger_common.sh`, sets the dump and build output paths, and supports a `--no-redownload` option to reuse an existing ledger archive. If needed, it downloads and extracts the `devnet-398736132-solcap` ledger from Google Cloud Storage, updates the ledger configuration file with local paths and test settings, and then runs `firedancer-dev configure init`, `backtest`, and `configure fini`. After the run, it imports bank hash details into a Solana capture file, diffs the result with `fd_solcap_diff`, and checks the ledger checksum again to confirm that the test did not corrupt the ledger data.
